description:
##All participants drinking alcohol must be age 21 or over, with valid ID.
Guests drinking alcohol must be 21+. Guests 18-20 are permitted on our tours but may not be allowed into certain establishments. Guests 17 and younger must purchase a private tour.
##About
San Diego County is actually where wineries and viticulture (the science, production, and study of grapes) began in the Golden State! Let us do the driving and you do the drinking! This tour includes two visits to local, family run vineyards with a knowledgeable and passionate guide to teach you about the process of winemaking, and a delicious winery meal. You'll learn about the history of the winery and about San Diego's role in creating a booming California wine culture.
what_is_included:
**Highlights of this VIP guided adventure include:**
• Approx. 4.5 hour VIP guided adventure to stunning and unique local vineyards.
• Ample tasting and large pours of local wines.
• Entertaining commentary on local history, and viticulture.
• Transportation (from convenient meeting locations).
• Wine tasting appreciation presentation, and guided winery tour.
• Delicious Winery Meal
• Complete coordination by San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits Tours.
• **Includes a $30 value: 2 free Self-Guided Virtual Tours (Waterfront & Old Town). Access details are included in your confirmation email.**

Above adventure includes wine tastings, food, transportation, entertainment, and San Diego Beer, Wine & Spirits expert guide.
